blocks.text: Fraser Valley Housing Market April 2026: Inventory Up, Prices Holding

parts.t: April brought a clear shift across the
Fraser Valley real estate market April 2026

: inventory climbed in every major city, but prices mostly held their ground. For buyers eyeing detached homes, leverage is opening up — particularly in Surrey and the upper price tiers of South Surrey/White Rock. Sellers in pockets like Walnut Grove and Cloverdale are still firmly in the driver's seat.
Buyers' market at 8% sales ratio. Average sale price $1,347,750 (up 3% from March). Inventory 1,064 (up 14%).
Buyers' market at 11% sales ratio. Average sale price $1,845,000 (up 9%). Inventory 629 (up 14%). Days on market dropped from 33 to 21.
Balanced market at 18% sales ratio. Average sale price $1,398,000. Inventory 449 (up 11%). Days on market dropped from 22 to 14.
Sellers' market at 21% sales ratio. Average sale price $645,000.
Balanced market at 20% sales ratio. Solds up 48% month-over-month.
Balanced market at 14% sales ratio. Average sale price $1,063,600.

blocks.text: Where Buyers Have Leverage Right Now

parts.t: Surrey detached is the clearest buyer opportunity in the Fraser Valley this month. With a sales ratio of 8% — roughly 8 in 100 listed homes sold — there's time, choice, and negotiation room.

Not every pocket has cooled. Walnut Grove is leading the

at a 41% sales ratio — well into sellers' territory. Cloverdale's 3-4 bedroom homes are moving quickly, and South Surrey's premium neighbourhoods — Elgin Chantrell, Grandview, Morgan Creek, and Pacific Douglas — continue to outperform.
The most active price band across multiple cities is the $900K–$1M range, where competition stays strong. If your home fits that profile, it's likely your moment.

blocks.text: Is the Fraser Valley a buyer's or seller's market in April 2026?

parts.t: It's mixed. Surrey detached (8%), South Surrey/White Rock detached (11%), and North Delta detached (8%) are buyers' markets. Langley detached is balanced at 18%, while Langley attached is a sellers' market at 21%.
What's the average home price in Langley right now?
Langley detached homes averaged $1,398,000 in April 2026, with inventory at 449 listings. Langley attached (condos and townhomes) averaged $645,000.

blocks.text: Are home prices going up or down in Surrey?

parts.t: Surrey detached prices rose 3% from March to April 2026, with the average sale price at $1,347,750. Inventory climbed 14% to 1,064 listings, giving buyers more leverage.
What's the hottest neighbourhood in Langley?
Walnut Grove, with a 41% sales ratio — firmly a sellers' market. Willoughby Heights leads Langley attached at strong sellers' levels too.
